_comment: Copy this to %USERPROFILE%\.zamolxis\rvsq-config.json and fill in ONE ENTRY PER PERSON you want watched (yourself, a spouse, kids…). This file stays on your machine only — never committed, logged, or sent anywhere but the official RVSQ site. RVSQ's login needs: first_name, last_name, nam, card_seq_number and DATE OF BIRTH (day/month/year) — there is NO card-expiry field. nam = the health-insurance number on the RAMQ card; card_seq_number = the small SEQUENTIAL number printed after the name on the card; birth_month = 1-12 (or the French month name, e.g. "mars"). Optional per-person overrides: headless, radius_km, consulting_reason. Set "disabled": true on an entry to skip it. headless/radius_km at the top level are defaults for everyone.
